images.caption: A French air force Mirage aircraft breaks formation after refueling from a U.S. Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker aircraft assigned to the 351st Expeditionary Air Refueling Squadron (EARS) over Mali, April 9, 2013. The 351st EARS has been supporting the French fighter aircraft over Mali since Jan. 27, 2013, allowing the fighter aircraft the ability to provide their ground forces with around-the-clock close air support. (DoD photo by 1st Lt. Christopher Mesnard, U.S. Air Force/Released)
images.alt: A French air force Mirage aircraft breaks formation after refueling from a U.S. Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker aircraft assigned to the 351st Expeditionary Air Refueling Squadron (EARS) over Mali, April 9, 2013. The 351st EARS has been supporting the French fighter aircraft over Mali since Jan. 27, 2013, allowing the fighter aircraft the ability to provide their ground forces with around-the-clock close air support. (DoD photo by 1st Lt. Christopher Mesnard, U.S. Air Force/Released)

images.caption: French soldiers help a U.S. Air Force crew with the 4th Airlift Squadron, 62nd Airlift Wing unload French military cargo after a flight from Base Aerienne 125 in Istres, France, to Bamako, Mali, Jan. 25, 2013. The flight included transportation of military vehicles, equipment and personnel. U.S. Air Force aircraft under U.S. Africa Command provided logistical support to French forces in support of France's efforts to restore security in Mali. (DoD photo by Senior Airman Brandi Hansen, U.S. Air Force/Released)
images.alt: French soldiers help a U.S. Air Force crew with the 4th Airlift Squadron, 62nd Airlift Wing unload French military cargo after a flight from Base Aerienne 125 in Istres, France, to Bamako, Mali, Jan. 25, 2013. images.caption: A French Dassault Mirage 2000 pilot prepares to link up with a U.S. Air Force KC-135R Stratotanker May 3, 2013, over Mali. The French-led operation received assistance from U.S. aerial refueling tankers deployed from the 100th Air Refueling Wing that flew its 200th mission with the French May 5. The KC-135R is assigned to the 351st Expeditionary Air Refueling Squadron. (U.S. Air Force photo by 1st Lt. Christopher Mesnard)
